text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Oguri Cap's first goal is to get her
name out there and gain more
popularity, we decide to
enter a lot of
different races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at a racecourse hosting a
special
exhibition race, when...

text_block_list.name: Yone
text_block_list.text: Hey, Oguri! It's been a while!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you guys doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Oguri Cap's line of sight to find
a group
of people waving and cheering
excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you look like you've had the
shock of a
lifetime! Seems like our
surprise was a big success!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! I thought I'd wandered
my way
back home by mistake.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! I forgot to introduce you.
These are all
folks from my hometown.
choice_data_list: Oguri Cap, could these people be...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let me introduce you to everyone. This
is my
trainer, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She briefly introduces me, and they
greet me very warmly. The people from
Oguri Cap's hometown are just as kind as
she always makes them out to
be.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You guys came all this way just to see
me? It's
such a long trip...

text_block_list.name: Take
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Our Oguri's finally made her
debut!
There's no way we could stay
home in the sticks
twiddling our thumbs!

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
We all wanted to see you give it your all
in a
central race, so we came to cheer
you on!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you all so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the people from her hometown take turns
expressing their support, a smile
gradually
appears on Oguri Cap's face.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that Oguri Cap over there? I
heard that
absolutely no one stood a
chance against her
back in Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but that was Kasamatsu. The Twinkle Series is in a whole other league.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, who do you think's gonna be in
the next
race? I've got my hopes up for
Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's gotta be Super Creek! I mean,
she's...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I've gotta go and get ready.

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
A-all right... But hold on a minute,
Oguri. Are you
okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Okay with what?

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're fine, that's all that
matters,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
You're more than welcome to come
home if things
get too tough out here,
you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Take
text_block_list.text:
We'll always be your loudest supporters!
Make
sure to listen to us and no one
else, all right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
U-uh, okay... Thank you? Today's just an

exhibition race though, so I hope you
guys enjoy
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once Oguri Cap's hometown friends
send us on
our way, I notice that she still
looks puzzled—as if she doesn't
understand why they were so worried 
about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that they probably heard some

thoughtless comments coming from the
other
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So that's why they were worried
about me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
People will think what they want, so I
just ignore
the negativity.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... But I guess it's making everybody
else
uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. Another reason for me
enter lots of
races.
choice_data_list: Once you win, all that chatter wil...
Once you win, all that chatter wil...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure everyone in this city
acknowledges
me—I promise.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But first, I have to win this race and let
everyone
know I'm doing okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Oguri Cap surges
ahead in the homestretch and, in a
stunning victory, shows her hometown
supporters the true measure of her
skill.
